reason: I don't trust packaged green chutney to stay fresh without sour vinegar and artificial stabilizers, and watery separation would ruin my rolls and momos.
objection: Green chutney in a tube will either be pumped with vinegar preservatives or separate into watery sludge when squeezed.
would_change_my_mind: A clean-label guarantee with zero vinegar or artificial preservatives, plus a non-drip emulsion nozzle.
